ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 12, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

Barbara A. Pollack, Chair  Lani De Benedictis, Commissioner
Chief Coleman, Vice Chair  Robert Gill, Commissioner
Raul Añorve, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56967  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Ethics Commission meeting of
  Wednesday, October 8, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56968  Recommendation to discuss recommendations of the May 2025 report from the Ad
  Hoc Committee on Commission Responsibilities.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56974  Recommendation to discuss the definition and reporting process for non-financial
  conflicts of interest, as outlined in the City’s Code of Conduct and Ethics; and, if
  appropriate, make a recommendation to the Mayor and City Council.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-56969  Recommendation to discuss the 2026 calendar of events for the Ethics
  Commission and strategies to boost public participation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-56970  Recommendation to discuss, and if appropriate, take action on canceling one
  meeting of the Ethics Commission during the 2026 calendar year.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 3
   ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 12, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

6.  25-56971  Recommendation to discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming
  projects; and, if appropriate, take action to dissolve, create or reauthorize Ad Hoc
  Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-56972  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ethics Officer.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  25-56973  Recommendation to discuss potential agenda items for future Commission
  meetings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Ethics Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Matthew Bunma, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.

If written language translation of the Commission agenda and minutes for non-English speaking

5.  25-56970  Recommendation to discuss, and if appropriate, take action on canceling one

  A motion was made by Commissioner Eaton, seconded by Commissioner
  Gillette, that the item be laid over to the next regularly scheduled Ethics
  Commission meeting. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Añorve, Eaton, Gill, Gillette, Coleman, Pollack
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None

6.  25-56971  Recommendation to discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming
  projects; and, if appropriate, take action to dissolve, create or reauthorize Ad Hoc
  Committees.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Gill, seconded by Commissioner
  Eaton, to approve recommendation, as amended, to [1] establish an Ad Hoc
  Committee on Commission Responsibilities whose members are Chair
  Pollack, Commissioner Gillette, and Commissioner Eaton; [2] establish an Ad
  Hoc Committee on Social Media and Campaign Activity whose members are
  Chair Pollack, Vice Chair Coleman and Commissioner Gill; [3] remove Vice
  Chair Coleman from the Ad Hoc Committee on Policies Review and add
  Commissioner Añorve to the Ad Hoc Committee on Policies Review. The
  motion carried by the following vote:
